rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Parliament's release dated Thursday 15 February 2018 says the Speaker 'has today, 15 February, received a letter from President Jacob Zuma informing her of his resignation', that 'The resignation of the President is effective immediately', and that the Chief Justice's availability moved the election of the President from Friday 16 February 2018 to 14:00 that day, in place of the proposed no-confidence motion.
